desc:
• DELICIOUS TASTE: Each box of crunchy lattice squares brings an irresistible blueberry taste your whole family can enjoy; Keep a box in your pantry for a morning food that's ready to eat any time

  • WHOLE GRAIN: Helps get your day off to a good start with 13g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily)

  • GLUTEN FREE CEREAL: Pour some in a bowl with milk for a great-tasting, gluten free part of an easy breakfast; Pack some in a lunch box or backpack for snacks on the go; Add to homemade cereal bars as snacks for kids

  • VITAMINS AND MINERALS: Beyond the delicious taste, every serving is a good source of 12 vitamins and minerals, and made without high fructose corn syrup, or artificial flavors or colors

  • CONTAINS: One 12 oz box of Blueberry Flavored Chex Cereal
features:
Features

Naturally Flavored Blueberry Cereal
Light, crispy rice squares with a sweet blueberry coating for a fruity twist on classic Chex.

Made with Whole Grain Rice
Contains 13 grams of whole grain per serving to support a balanced diet.

100% Gluten-Free
Ideal for individuals with gluten intolerance or those following a gluten-free lifestyle.

No Artificial Colors or High-Fructose Corn Syrup
Crafted with a clean ingredient list and naturally flavored for peace of mind.

Fortified with Essential Nutrients
Includes 12 vitamins and minerals like iron, calcium, vitamin D, and B vitamins.

Kosher Certified
Suitable for a wide range of dietary preferences and needs.

Benefits

Flavorful Yet Wholesome
Offers the fruity sweetness of blueberries with a satisfying crunch, perfect for breakfast or snacking.

Supports Immune and Energy Health
Fortification with key nutrients helps contribute to your daily nutritional intake.

Kid-Approved Taste
Slightly sweet and fun to eat, making it a hit with kids and adults alike.

Versatile Use
Enjoy with milk, yogurt, or as a dry snack. Also great in snack mixes, trail mixes, or no-bake desserts.

Crunch That Lasts
Stays crisp even after adding milk—no soggy spoonfuls.

Great for On-the-Go
Pack it dry in bags or containers for a quick and easy snack anytime.
ingredients: Whole Grain Rice, Rice, Sugar, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, Blueberry Powder, Molasses, Natural Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamin and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
